items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: He could burn which one up? Pete Nugent. Pete Nugent. Because he raised hell with Fats about the time.

ctx.x: Look, we never did call him Little Rock on the back. No, no. So I got Fats Martin which was a blessing in disguise. Because this guy turned out to be to me one of the greatest drummers that I'd ever heard. He had a bad tendency though to increase time sometimes. Well sometimes it was bad if we were playing a show similar to the one we played with in Detroit, Michigan. And he had this guy, Pete Peaches of Duke, had great, great dances out of the cotton club. But Pete had gone, Pete Nugent had gone and the singer.…
And of course that's, we just scratching the surface when we start talking about the foys of your band and everything. How many drummers have you known that didn't increase? How many of them?
